selection: Review all four dreams first; at most one clear best/worse contrast per request. No length-ratio cutoff or minimum-ratio pair selection. No fabricated negatives. Ties/uncertainty excluded.

training.optimizer: new AdamW, reset moments; source optimizer untouched
training.credit_assignment: entire sampled continuation including dream and answer; prompt/prefill excluded
training.reference: stationary checkpoint 32, scores cached before first update
training.selection: 12 to 24 clear pairs, one per request; at least three chosen dreams longer and three shorter; otherwise not ready. Operational sequence <=1536, never truncate/recode.

evaluation.unit: 24 novel development requests, four paired samples per model/request
evaluation.primary: Blind assistant preference on dream quality; ties and no_se allowed; frozen before source key; no source-alternating order
evaluation.aggregation: Mean score within each request, then equally across 24 requests; no dropped failures
evaluation.interval: Percentile bootstrap of 24 entire request clusters, 20000 replicates, seed 20261031; 95% exploratory interval including all ties/no_se

promotion_all_required.motif_review: Independent axis on all 96 dreams/model, including copied requests: central roles, objects and relations; count any major unsupported omission or contradiction once/sample. No single human target for these requests.
promotion_all_required.variety_review: 24 blind groups of four samples/model; distinct episodes/relations, not lexical novelty; ties/no_se allowed and reported
promotion_all_required.dependency: Repeat exactly v19 anchor/edited/paraphrase, 18 after answers vs frozen 32 baseline; do not grant partial facts

evaluation.failure_policy: Any gate fails or review missing => keep32; no additional epochs, checkpoint selection or threshold changes based on results
evaluation.limitations: Same assistant reviews training and evaluation; development, not independent human validation; bootstrap does not include reviewer uncertainty. Success is provisional, no subjective-experience claim.
